question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Fertility
solution:
The correct answer is: **Dryness**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"fertility"** means the quality of being able to produce offspring, crops, etc.; it refers to the capability of producing abundant vegetation or offspring. (उर्वरता)

 
 
• **Example: **The **fertility **of the soil ensured a good harvest year after year.
 
 
 
• **"Dryness"** refers to the state or condition of being dry, lacking moisture, or being unproductive. (सूखापन)
 
 
• **Example: **The drought caused severe **dryness **in the region, making it difficult to grow crops.
 
 
 
• Hence, the antonym of **'fertility'** is **'dryness'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Fruitfulness** (फलदायकता): The quality of producing good results or being productive.

 
 
• **Example:** The **fruitfulness **of the project was evident in the high returns and satisfied stakeholders.
 
 
 
• **Tenderness** (मुलायमता): The quality of being gentle, loving, or kind.
 
 
• **Example: **The **tenderness **with which she cared for the old man was touching.
 
 
 
• **Innovation** (नवाचार): The action or process of innovating or introducing new ideas or methods.
 
 
• **Example:** The company's commitment to **innovation **has kept it at the forefront of the tech industry.
